text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the Bahraini press on Sunday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Bahrain to host aluminium exhibition in November.
- Jewellery worth $10 million will be shown in the Indian Jewellery Exhibition to be held in Bahrain on February 24.
- Two International Labour Organisation experts to arrive in Bahrain on Sunday to help upgrade Bahrain labour market data.
- United Arab Emirates welcomes meeting between crown prince and Qatar's foreign minister in London last week.
- Bahrain to join GCC-European Union talks to be held in Doha on Monday.
